identityNotes: There is no canonical QMS_DHF registry ID. QMS_DESIGN_CONTROLS is the cross-cutting DHF/design-controls identity. US_DHF already belongs to medical_devices and is separately reachable.
IEC_62304 and ISO_CIP already belong to medical_devices and are not part of this seven-record exclusion.
No truly absent exact shared blueprint among these seven; dedicated record-specific DHR, DMR and MDSAP content schemas are absent. Seven generic QMS headings are not those actual records.

staticTrace.detail: Each active entry has device/ivd-only productClass; defaultSectionBlueprint is exact lowercase registry ID plus _sections.

All seven exact blueprint IDs map to QMS_SECTIONS. The generic seven groups include policy, roles, document control, design controls, production, CAPA and audit; source guidance contains legacy QSR citations 820.30/.40/.70/.100.

No lifecycle/component/dedicated mapping for these exact IDs; exactBlueprint accepts their matching nonempty shared blueprint and projectOutline retains exact registry identity. authoringFamilies is empty because format/standard is none. Coverage excludes them by segment.

Both roster and UUID lookup share the segment filter that excludes cross_cutting. No exactComponentMetadata maps these IDs, so aiDraftable defaults false; reaching them adds seven manual preparation projections without changing UUID derivation.

The existing predicate already admits cross_cutting entries whose nonempty productClass is entirely device/ivd. Direct get_document_template registry references therefore already reach device preparation.
Already permits these active device-only cross-cutting entries. UUID reference is currently unreachable only because the builtin exact lookup excludes them.
Existing quality_manual template and generic controlled procedure/form/policy/work-instruction templates are separate module-owned identities, not these seven registry records.
Quality registration uses governed Authoring transactions and QMS registration/signature/revision ownership; ordinary Authoring preparation drafts do not become registered controlled documents.
Quality already embeds the same DocumentWorkbench pinned to its controlled version, consumeDeepLinks=false. No new editor or QMS creator is needed.

safeMinimalReachability: Admit only the existing cross_cutting entries with a nonempty productClass consisting entirely of medical_device/ivd, within existing supported regions, consistently in builtin listing/exact lookup and coverage. Do not admit arbitrary any-product cross_cutting records.

Keep all seven manual preparation; original signed DHRs/batch records, specifications/DMR, design reviews/verification, audit reports and certificates remain source records. An authoring scaffold neither fabricates nor replaces their execution/approval.

Disclose limited scope, sponsor applicability and current QMSR/source versions; repair or explicitly qualify historical QSR citations before new exposure. Root elected record-specific limited groups for exact seven mappings plus US_DHF, preserving generic QMS_SECTIONS.
Preserve existing Quality module registration, versioning, approval and training paths. Do not present a plain Authoring worksheet as a registered/effective Quality record or certification.
Seven additions would increase the currently qualified385 builtins to392; this is a static expected count, not a runtime inventory receipt.

postRepairStaticReview.scope: Read-only source review after root applied the bounded reachability and record-specific outline changes. No runtime/test qualification by this reviewer. These are review-time historical pins, not final release pins.
findings: isDeviceRegistryEntry preserves the nonempty all-device/ivd productClass restriction for cross_cutting entries, excluding arbitrary any-product records.
Builtin roster and exact UUID lookup share regionalEntries; both selectors and registry coverage now use the same registry predicate. The API integration loop includes the same seven entries.
Each newly reachable registry identity remains manual preparation with blank content and no inferred CTD module. The exact metadata lookup has no AI-eligible component for these IDs.
Seven exact QMS mappings plus US_DHF use limited record-specific groups in the existing device source. Generic QMS_SECTIONS remains unchanged.
New groups use current QMSR820.10 with applicability/source limitations; MDSAP and DHR retain original independent report and executed/signed record limits.
Existing Quality registration, controlled revisions, approval and embedded single editor remain unchanged. No new creator, editor, transport or authorization path is introduced.
